_backcheck._comment: Ignored by Claude Code. Empirical facts about config C, consumed by runtime/scripts/sandbox-backcheck.py.
_backcheck.dbus_note: User D-Bus is unreachable even with allowAllUnixSockets: systemctl/journalctl/systemd-run/busctl --user, notify-send, gdbus, secret-tool, gio all fail.
_backcheck.nix_note: nix and nix-* go through the nix-memory-run wrapper, which calls systemd-run --user, so they inherit the D-Bus break.
_backcheck.gh_note: gh reads its token from the keyring over D-Bus secret-service (unreachable) and ~/.config/gh is Read-denied, so gh is unauthenticated.
_backcheck.git_https_note: Derived, not separately measured: git's https credential helper is 'gh auth git-credential', so authenticated https git (push; fetch of private repos) inherits the gh break.
_backcheck.read_deny_note: Assumption, unverified: Read(//**/.git/**) is not enforced inside the sandbox, since enforcing it would break every git command. All other Read() deny rules are treated as enforced.
_backcheck.ssh_note: ~/.ssh is unreadable (Read deny rules carry into the sandbox), so ssh, scp, sftp, ssh-transport rsync and git@ remotes break.
_backcheck.network_mode: egress only to allowedDomains via proxy; no raw DNS, no localhost services
